name: Sangamon Solar
old_description: "Sangamon Solar was exceptional in their explanation of benefits of going solar and all the government incentives. They walked me through the process, provided financing options for the balance of my purchase and provided a professional and courteous staff of installers to work on my home."
about:
Sangamon Solar is a solar installation and service company headquartered in Champaign, Illinois. The company operates as an approved vendor and equity-eligible contractor under Illinois energy programs.

The company designs and installs rooftop, ground-mounted, and ballast-mounted solar arrays for residential and commercial customers. Installations use Ironridge mounting hardware with triple-sealed roof penetrations. Every system includes a workmanship warranty, equipment warranties up to 25 years, and 15 years of performance monitoring. Sangamon Solar also provides permitting, interconnection, and Renewable Energy Credit (REC) processing through the Illinois Shines program, and offers maintenance for systems it did not originally install.

Customers include homeowners seeking to offset electricity costs, commercial building owners looking to reduce overhead, and “stranded customers” who need assistance retrieving REC payments from existing installations. The firm also offers zero-money-down leasing options and energy consulting for both homes and businesses.

Sangamon Solar distinguishes itself by handling the full project lifecycle—from design and permitting to long-term monitoring and REC compliance—and by serving as a primary vendor for the state’s stranded-customer REC recovery efforts.

old_description: Sattler Manufacturing is the trusted custom metal fabrication shop of Nashville, Tennessee. We combine decades of industrial fabrication experience with modern metal shop technologies, such as laser cutting. We work with stainless steel, aluminum, and mild steels to shear, bend, laser cut, weld, form, and build custom parts, equipment, and structures.
about:
Sattler Manufacturing operates from Nashville, Tennessee, where it runs a custom metal fabrication shop serving Middle Tennessee. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but describes itself as combining decades of industrial fabrication experience with modern metal shop technologies such as laser cutting.

The shop works with stainless steel, aluminum, and mild steel to shear, bend, laser cut, weld, form, and build custom parts, equipment, and structures. Its capabilities include laser cutting, custom metal fabrication, facility maintenance (welding, pipefitting), assembly, on-site installation, and prototyping. In-house design and engineering services cover CAD drafting, 3D solid modeling, value engineering, project management, and manufacturability reviews, supported by software such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, and Trumpf TruTops.

Industrial engineering, operations, plant, maintenance, and safety managers across Middle Tennessee rely on Sattler for material handling, piping, structural, food processing, manufacturing, safety, and machine operations projects. The company also serves manufacturers, machinists, and engineers needing custom sheet metal cutting and parts production.

Sattler emphasizes its blend of long-standing fabrication expertise with current laser technology, a "to-spec" guarantee on finished products, and the ability to work from client CAD files or develop designs from napkin sketches.

about:
Savannah Food Company, based in Savannah, Tennessee, traces its roots to 1970 when Bob Hagy, after decades in the restaurant business, began producing hushpuppies using family recipes. The Catfish Hotel Restaurant, still operating today, had built a reputation for its freshly made hushpuppies, prompting Hagy to build a dedicated processing facility. In 2004, the company was acquired by John Bryan, whose family had founded Bryan Foods, Inc. in the early 1900s.

The company operates a food processing facility that manufactures hushpuppies and side dishes, including original, jalapeño, and sweet corn varieties. Its quality system incorporates a hazard analysis and critical control points (HACCP) plan, good manufacturing practices (GMP), and alignment with global food safety initiatives (GFSI). The facility has held FSSC 22000 certification since June 2013, a globally recognized food safety standard based on ISO principles.

Savannah Food Company supplies wholesome, easy-to-prepare hushpuppies and side dishes to customers seeking authentic Southern recipes. Its products are positioned as comparable to scratch-made family meals.

The business emphasizes food safety and quality as the responsibility of every employee, backed by preventive control management, continuous improvement, and the FSSC 22000 certification. The original processing facility was built to replicate the restaurant-quality hushpuppies that made the Catfish Hotel famous.

name: Saw Logs To Lumber
old_description: At Saw Logs to Lumber, we specialize in custom woodworking and sawmilling. We have numerous logs in our lot ready to cut; you can pick one out and get it cut however you want or choose from our vast inventory of live edge slabs and hardwood to lumber in the shop.
about:
Saw Logs to Lumber operates from a Boschertown building on North Highway 94 in St. Charles, Missouri. The company traces its start to 1994, when Wayne, a Vietnam War veteran and former Boeing technical representative, purchased the floodplain property after recognizing its highway visibility and proximity to his then-employer. Wayne’s woodworking roots reach back to age 13, when a neighbor’s unpaid debt led him to acquire a table saw and lumber, with which he built a boat and dock.

The shop runs two sawmills and maintains an inventory exceeding 50,000 board feet of live-edge slabs alongside more than 800 logs, all sourced from Missouri-native species such as walnut, cherry, oak, and sassafras. Beyond milling customer-supplied logs, the team produces custom furniture and accessories—tables, paddles, benches, charcuterie boards, bartops, and mantel pieces—while also selling dimensional lumber to contractors, builders, and DIY enthusiasts.

Customers range from professional contractors and builders seeking sustainable Missouri hardwood to hobbyists commissioning one-off pieces. The business also serves woodworkers who bring their own logs for custom milling, offering a full chain from raw log to finished slab or product.

Wayne describes himself as a “Tree Whisperer,” aiming to let each piece of wood “speak for itself” by revealing its unique grain and character. The venture began as a retirement pursuit after decades at Boeing, driven by a desire to honor the natural beauty of local timber rather than chase volume metrics.

name: Schaumburg Specialties - Racks & Carts
old_description: From industrial bakeries and donut CMLs to airline catering commissaries and prepared meal facilities, SHOPCraft delivers high-performance oven racks, bakery carts, processing tables, and dough troughs that keep your production line running smoothly.
about:
Schaumburg Specialties operates from Schaumburg, Illinois, producing custom metal racks and carts for food production and industrial applications. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founder names.

The company manufactures oven racks, bakery carts, processing tables, dough troughs, donut racks, speed racks, pan racks, lug racks, sheet pans, wire screens, and nesting racks under the SHOPCraft, KWIKCraft, and AGRICraft product lines. Its capabilities include custom metal fabrication, welded construction, design and engineering, bulk product development, and maintenance and equipment servicing. All products are built using all-welded construction with top-of-the-line materials such as 18-gauge aluminum and stainless steel, and carry a lifetime guarantee.

Schaumburg Specialties serves industrial bakeries, donut production lines, airline catering commissaries, prepared meal facilities, meat and seafood processors, pet food manufacturers, and agriculture and indoor farming operations. Customer references include David's Burgers, Bimbo, Udi's (Pinnacle Foods), Illinois State University, Carolina CPL Co-Op, and businesses in Appleton, WI; Elk Grove, IL; and Chapel Hill, NC.

The company emphasizes American-made, tariff-free production and positions its welded, low-maintenance designs as a durability differentiator. It highlights NSF-certified donut basket racks and anodized coatings as premium features that justify higher upfront cost over cheaper alternatives.

old_description: Energy costs keep rising, leaving you with few choices. Solar power gives you an energy alternative and the independence you’re looking for. Become energy independent, slash your energy bill, and take control of your future with solar power.
about:
Seal Solar is based in North Little Rock, Arkansas. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It operates as a solar energy installer and service provider.

The company designs and installs solar photovoltaic systems paired with battery storage, notably offering a microgrid package that includes 4.6 kW of solar capacity using 12 high-efficiency modules, racking, and a Tesla Powerwall 3 unit with integrated inverter and gateway. It also provides service and maintenance for residential and commercial solar installations, and facilitates project financing through partnerships with state banks for commercial clients.

Seal Solar serves homeowners and businesses across Arkansas. Residential customers include families such as the Murrays, Golden, and Davis households, who have documented reduced electricity bills after installation. On the commercial side, the company works with businesses seeking to finance capital projects through state-backed lending programs.

The company emphasizes energy independence and protection against rising utility rates and weather-related outages as the core reasons customers choose its solar-plus-storage solutions.

name: Selby Electric
old_description: Selby Electric specializes in residential and commercial electrical services. Whether you need a small electrical wiring fix, have an issue that needs troubleshooting, or installation of state-of-the-art smart home technology, Selby Electric will get the job done right. Looking for a reliable electrician around Bismarck or Mandan? You’ve found me!
about:
Selby Electric operates from Mandan, North Dakota, serving Bismarck, Mandan, and the surrounding Burleigh and Morton counties. The business is owned and operated by Craig Selby, a North Dakota Master Electrician (license #M4002) with over 30 years of hands-on experience in residential and commercial electrical work. Selby established the company as a locally owned operation, though the exact founding year is not publicly stated.

The firm provides a full range of electrical services rather than manufactured products. Its offerings include recessed lighting installation, ceiling fan mounting and circuit wiring, electrical panel upgrades to meet current code, scheduled preventive maintenance inspections, wiring and repair from faulty outlets to full rewires, room addition and build-out wiring, shop wiring for 240V outlets and sub-panels, troubleshooting of tripping breakers and flickering lights, remodel project coordination for kitchens and bathrooms, and EV charger installation. Selby performs all work personally without subcontractors.

Customers span both residential and commercial sectors. Homeowners hire Selby for lighting upgrades, panel replacements, and smart-home or EV charger installations. Commercial clients include local businesses and shops needing heavy-duty circuits, sub-panels, and code-compliant wiring for expansions or renovations. The company coordinates directly with general contractors on remodel projects to keep schedules on track.

Selby emphasizes direct accountability: the owner is on every job site, communicates clearly, and aims to complete work correctly the first time. As a locally owned business, he stresses long-term community relationships and a personal commitment to safety and code compliance.
